title: Optimal portfolio choice under green transition timing risk
abstract: arXiv:2610.33597v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study an investor's optimal portfolio choice problem when they account for the impact of a possible future green transition, whose timing is uncertain. We model the green transition as a discontinuity in the stock price processes, driven by a single jump process with constant intensity, in which 'green' stocks increase in value and 'brown' stocks decrease in value. The investor is ambiguous about the timing of the green transition and designs an investment strategy which is robust to this risk. The investor has constant relative risk aversion preferences over both wealth and model ambiguity, which introduce a multiplicative ambiguity penalty for power utility and an additive ambiguity penalty for log utility. We separate the problem into pre- and post-transition cases, derive the solution, and provide a verification theorem. We further show that the log utility, ambiguity-neutral, and worst-case problems are obtained as special cases

translated_title: 绿色转型时机风险下的最优投资组合选择
translated_abstract: 我们研究了投资者在考虑未来可能发生的绿色转型影响时的最优投资组合选择问题，而该转型的时机是不确定的。我们将绿色转型建模为股票价格过程中的一个不连续跳跃，由一个具有恒定强度的单一跳过程驱动，其中“绿色”股票价值上升，“棕色”股票价值下降。投资者对绿色转型的时机存在模糊性认知，并据此设计对这一风险具有稳健性的投资策略。投资者对财富和模型模糊性均具有常相对风险厌恶（CRRA）偏好，这使得幂效用下引入乘法形式的模糊性惩罚，而对数效用下引入加法形式的模糊性惩罚。我们将问题分为转型前和转型后两种情形，推导出解并给出了验证定理。我们进一步证明，对数效用、模糊中性以及最坏情形等问题均可作为本文模型的特例得到。
tldr: 本文针对绿色转型时机不确定的风险，研究了具有模糊厌恶的CRRA投资者如何构建稳健的最优投资组合，通过将转型建模为绿色股票升值、棕色股票贬值的跳跃过程，求解了转型前后的最优策略并给出验证定理。
en_tdlr: This paper derives robust optimal portfolio strategies for a CRRA investor facing uncertain timing of a green transition, modeled as a jump that raises green stocks and lowers brown stocks, solving pre- and post-transition cases with a verification theorem.
